dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible along the mid-dorsal ridge, characterized by irregular, light-tan perimeters approximately 3-8 pixels wide that transition sharply into dark-brown interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid light-tan pixel clusters located along the lower lateral flank and cranial-dorsal region, appearing as asymmetrical flecks without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal macro-annuli form a scalene triangle, while a secondary cluster of four smaller annuli in the posterior region forms a trapezoidal geometric relationship.

other_distinctive_markers: Deeply recessed vertical integumentary folds are present across the posterior flukes, creating a series of high-contrast parallel shadow lines.
